name: tripo-studio-opencli
description: Tripo Studio browser workflows with explicit budgets, single-attempt receipts and Blender handoff.

interface.longDescription: Skills-only plugin for an existing OpenCLI Browser Bridge. Includes self-authored adapters and local workflow scripts; requires separate local dependencies and explicit cloud budgets.
interface.defaultPrompt: 使用 Tripo Studio 技能，先核对已有浏览器连接、地区、来源和本次具体预算，再准备生成或 Blender 交接。
